title: Privacy-Preserving Full-Body Meshing from mmWave Radar via Mesh Foundation Model Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2609.34768v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving human perception, but the extreme sparsity of point clouds from commercial single-chip sensors (mean ~6.5 points/frame; ~28% empty frames) has confined prior art to body-part keypoints or discrete action classification. We present a cross-modal teacher-student framework that lifts commercial radar to full-body, per-frame, metric 3D mesh reconstruction with per-joint uncertainty. Three innovations: (1) a mesh-foundation-model teacher - SAM 3D Body produces whole-body MHR ground truth (70 joints, 18,439 mesh vertices) from a single RGB frame with zero training, slashing annotation cost by orders of magnitude; (2) StudentPoseFormer - set encoding with masked attention pooling, a temporal Transformer, and a CVAE multi-hypothesis head that outputs both the pose mean and per-joint variance, honestly reporting where the radar cannot see; and (3) a multi-stage ground-truth quality pip

translated_title: 基于网格基础模型监督的毫米波雷达隐私保护全身网格重建
translated_abstract: 毫米波雷达能够实现隐私保护的人体感知，但商用单芯片传感器点云的极端稀疏性（平均每帧约6.5个点；约28%的帧为空帧）使得以往的研究仅局限于身体部位关键点或离散动作分类。我们提出了一种跨模态师生框架，将商用雷达提升至全身、逐帧、公制尺度的三维网格重建，并提供每个关节的不确定性估计。该框架包含三项创新：（1）网格基础模型教师——SAM 3D Body无需任何训练即可从单张RGB帧生成全身人体网格恢复（MHR）真值（70个关节、18,439个网格顶点），将标注成本降低了数个数量级；（2）StudentPoseFormer——采用带掩码注意力池化的集合编码、时间Transformer以及CVAE多假设头，同时输出姿态均值和每个关节的方差，诚实报告雷达无法观测到的部位；（3）多阶段真值质量管线……
tldr: 该论文提出一种跨模态师生框架，利用免训练的网格基础模型SAM 3D Body自动生成训练真值，使极度稀疏的商用毫米波雷达点云首次实现带每关节不确定性估计的全身逐帧三维人体网格重建。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a cross-modal teacher-student framework that leverages the training-free mesh foundation model SAM 3D Body to automatically generate ground truth, enabling extremely sparse commercial mmWave radar point clouds to achieve full-body, per-frame 3D human mesh reconstruction with per-joint uncertainty estimation for the first time.
